notes.title: Recorded gameplay by the devs
notes.content:
Shadow's Bullet is taking part in the Steam Next Fest.

Steam Next Fest is a week-long celebration featuring hundreds of free playable demos as well as developer livestreams and chats.

So, come and watch us play the game and do not hesitate to try the demo for free!

If you have any question, feel free to send us a message!

Wishlist Shadow's Bullet!

notes.title: The demo is out!
notes.content:
Shadow's Bullet Demo is now available!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2266300/Shadows_Bullet_Demo?snr=1_7_15__13

Be the invisible hunter in this multiplayer arena twin-stick shooter and bring your friends to play with up to 4 players! 
Grab the demo, gather some people, and play offline or online (via Steam Remote Play Together).
You'll have a lot of fun!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZTL8JZWLIwU

Join our discord server to find players to play!
Shadow's Bullet Discord Server:
https://discord.gg/Gqu55dA8gw
